Question Choices: How many sides does a quadrilateral have?
Hints: Count the straight sides of the closed shape.
Solution: A quadrilateral is a closed shape with four straight sides, so it has 4 sides.

Question Choices: Which shape is a quadrilateral?  (A) Triangle (B) Rectangle (C) Pentagon
Hints: Count the straight sides of the closed shape.
Solution: A rectangle has four straight sides, so choose B. A triangle has three sides and a pentagon has five.

Question Choices: Select. Is a square a quadrilateral? ~~Yes | No~~
Hints: Count the straight sides of the closed shape.
Solution: Yes. Every square has four straight sides and is therefore a quadrilateral.

Question Choices: What is special about a parallelogram? (A) Opposite sides are parallel   (B) All sides are curved  (C) It has 3 sides
Hints: Check pairs of parallel sides, equal sides and right angles. A shape can belong to more than one family.
Solution: Choose A. A parallelogram has two pairs of parallel opposite sides.

Question Choices: If lines would never cross even if extended, what do we call them?
Hints: Think about whether the complete lines could ever meet.
Solution: Lines in the same plane that never meet, even when extended in both directions, are parallel.

Question Choices: What makes a rhombus special?  (A) All sides are equal  (B) Only two sides are equal  (C) No sides are equal
Hints: Check pairs of parallel sides, equal sides and right angles. A shape can belong to more than one family.
Solution: Choose A. A rhombus has four equal sides.

Question Choices: Select. Is every rhombus also a quadrilateral? ~~Yes | No~~
Hints: Count the straight sides of the closed shape.
Solution: Yes. A rhombus has four straight sides, so it is a quadrilateral.

Question Choices: If two opposite sides of a shape are parallel and the other two are also parallel, what shape could it be?
Hints: Check pairs of parallel sides, equal sides and right angles. A shape can belong to more than one family.
Solution: Two pairs of parallel opposite sides define a parallelogram. Rectangles, rhombuses and squares also satisfy this definition.

Question Choices: Select. Is a square also a rectangle? ~~Yes | No~~
Hints: Check pairs of parallel sides, equal sides and right angles. A shape can belong to more than one family.
Solution: Yes. A rectangle is a quadrilateral with four right angles. A square has four right angles, so it is a rectangle too.

Question Choices: A quadrilateral has 4 right angles. What shape could it be?
Hints: Check pairs of parallel sides, equal sides and right angles. A shape can belong to more than one family.
Solution: A quadrilateral with four right angles is a rectangle. A square is also possible when all four sides are equal.

Question Choices: A shape has 4 sides and all sides are equal. What shape could it be?
Hints: Check pairs of parallel sides, equal sides and right angles. A shape can belong to more than one family.
Solution: Four equal sides make a rhombus. A square is a special rhombus with four right angles.
